name: Survive Lava for Animals
desc:
Survive LAVA for Animals! 🔥

Train speed to get faster and jump higher, but watch out for the LAVA!|

💡How to play: 
- Train speed on the treadmill to go faster and jump higher!🏃 
- Grab eggs and bring them back to your base!
- Watch out for the lava, don't let it touch you! 💀
- Hatch eggs to unlock RARE animals and make money!💵

Your animals earn money OFFLINE!💤 

Like the game and join the group for updates! 👍
